Mightier | Software Engineer | Hybrid (Boston) | Full-time

Mightier is a video game platform that helps kids mental health. Over a dozen clinical studies show efficacy on par with therapy and medication. http://mightier.com

Currently we're engaging with the healthcare system. Health insurance and Medicaid help make Mightier accessible to all kids who could benefit.

We're looking for help making it all work!
